newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Homes says lenders to forgive loans.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Homes says lenders to forgive loans.

text.p: Asahi Homes Co Ltd said on Tuesday that creditors had agreed to forgive loans they made to it worth 4.2 billion yen.
The company's accumulated losses have exceeded its shareholders' equity due to speculative real estate deals that have gone sour, it said.
Under an agreement mediated by Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd, lenders including Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd will forgive loans totalling 4.2 billion yen.

Asahi Homes will also sell land to its subsidiary, and instead of receiving money for the transaction, it will transfer five billion yen worth of its debts to the subsidiary, a spokesman for the company said.
